summary: Owner request (2026-11-05, #1010): source and defend the two open bridges of WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE. Pinned and read: Dei Filius ch. 4 and canons IV (Latin, vatican.va), CIC 1983 cann. 747-755 and 1364-1369 (Latin, vatican.va; Book VI as revised 2021), Summa contra Gentiles I.2 n.2-I.3 n.2 (Corpus Thomisticum), PU §373 (pinned German), SEP Fideism §3. (a) is supported by the practice's law of teaching (can. 749 §2), membership (cann. 750-751, 1364-1365), its self-description (Dei Filius ch. 4, can. IV.3 on the declared sense of dogma) and Wittgenstein's 'Theologie als Grammatik'; (b) by Dei Filius ch. 4 (two orders distinct in principle; God known by the gentiles) and SCG I.2-3 (natural reason to which all must assent, against pagans; the philosophers' proofs). The fideist replies are recorded at full strength as unattributed alternatives (conciliar teaching is theology, not grammar; natural reason within a theological horizon), with the supports they have (Phillips 2005, 75; Clayton and Taylor) and the texts against them as attacks. Rejected: recording either bridge as stated (no text states it; each source leaves a named gap) or the attacks as refutations (their premises are stated, not established). Logic-first follow-up for the Moorean candidate batch (#1119, 2026-11-06): the grammar-case vocabulary now exists (FIDEISM-GRAMMAR-CASES-PARTITION), so its absence is no longer the blocker. The exact original Challenge still has three unestablished inputs, including the stated CouncilDefinesNaturalKnowabilityReading, not only these two bridges. FideismFailsAsDescription is the negation of InternalGrammarReading ∧ CutOffReading; the recorded alternative to revelation is CutOffReading alone. No refutes relation targets that single rival. In-memory frontier settlement probes at main 0367eebc establish the bundle-failure result if all three inputs are hypothetically settled, but do not refute CutOffReading or lower any route. See docs/notes/moorean-floor-candidates.md for the ranked candidate batch, precise scopes and remaining registration/interpretation gaps. Natural-reason definition audit (2026-11-06): a typed modest descriptive-horizon sibling now separates theistic users/internal endorsement from absence of shared standards. Controls witness actual nonmember use within a theistic audience under shared, nonshared and mixed standard profiles. Nonmembership in one practice is not neutrality to every worldview. The original shared bridge is reused; all-nonshared and mixed positive/negative witness propositions are separate. EM checks shared/nonshared/mixed structural coverage; named uniform coverage stays open. The old horizon alternative now has the exact negation of the shared bridge as endpoint, derived only from all-nonshared plus an actual natural-knowability move, or by composing the mixed-profile rejection. The original prose horizon reconstruction and all source/support claims are unchanged. The existing shared statement paraphrase no longer implies internal endorsement is excluded: its Lean type never prohibited OwnStandard alongside shared standards. The defined conciliar move supplies a weaker actual natural-move witness; the two old grammar arguments still need Defined and record why. Rejected: theistic audience implies nonshared standards; non-Christian knowers stand outside every theological horizon; shared reasoning forbids own-standard endorsement; mixed witnesses refute a whole worldview; or a vacuous universal profile proves an actual natural move. Source warrant remains blocked; the conditional logical follow-up succeeds without deciding those source/applicability questions.
blocker: The two interpretation bridges and the council premise remain unestablished. Grammar-case vocabulary is available, but the original theorem refutes a conjunction, whereas the recorded revelation rival is its CutOffReading conjunct alone. A counted single-rival refutation needs a checked specialization with an established InternalGrammar/profile premise, or a justified revision to the recorded rival bundle, and all its premises established. The relation's external-signs/shared-reason reading also remains untyped. Two bridge approvals alone do not close revelation; more sourcing is not on the critical path. The natural-reason scope repair does not independently establish the shared or private interpretation; raw descriptive horizon survives either. Real universal-worldview neutrality would require a typed worldview/standard-admissibility semantics and independent applicability bridge absent from this profile. All source-attribution uncertainty and independent premise defense remain open; current conditional proofs do not require resolving them first.
